_about: Agenda Ahead Virginia (2026-11, gated): all 95 counties (Board of Supervisors, Planning Commission, BZA), the 38 independent cities and 41 towns where data-center, solar or battery fights are reported. Same row shape as towns_ma_all.json plus state, kind, selection_group / selection_reason / selection_source and the October county census bucket. Built by `python3 experiments/va_md_wave.py discover --state VA`; the 37 places of the October test (experiments/mi_va_test.py) keep their selection notes.
gate_note: Test state: not part of the production daily run. Crawled only by `python3 -m watch351.daily --states VA,MD --output-dir ../data/test/va_md --hits-name hits_va_md.json` (experiments/va_md_wave.py crawl).
evidence_rule: a board is automated only if its listing shows >=1 agenda/packet/notice dated within [today-120d, today+120d] and the first such document is fetchable under robots.txt
